poster_title: Difficulty-Aware Agentic Orchestration for Query-Specific Multi-Agent Workflows
authors: Jinwei Su, Qizhen Lan, Yinghui Xia, Lifan Sun, Weiyou Tian, Tianyu Shi, Lewei He, Yang Jingsong
paper_info: Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW '26), April 13-17, 2026, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

panels.headline: DAAO balances complexity and cost for query-specific multi-agent workflows.
content: DAAO dynamically generates workflows based on query difficulty.
Framework includes VAE, modular operator allocator, and cost-aware LLM router.
Self-adjusting policy updates difficulty estimates for efficiency.

panels.headline: Current frameworks lack complexity diversity and efficient query handling.
content: Task-level workflows over-process simple queries and underperform on complex ones.
Query-level workflows lack sufficient granularity for optimal strategies.
Need for a more flexible and cost-effective multi-agent system.

panels.headline: DAAO framework with VAE, allocator, and router.
content: VAE predicts query difficulty to guide workflow generation.
Modular operator allocator assigns tasks to appropriate agents.
Cost-aware LLM router optimizes resource allocation and performance.
panels.figure_caption: The overall framework of our proposed DAAO.

panels.headline: Visual representation of DAAO-generated workflows.
content: Colors represent different models assigned to each operator.
Demonstrates the dynamic and adaptive nature of DAAO.
panels.figure_caption: The visualization of the workflow generated by DAAO.

panels.headline: Experiments on six benchmarks: HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, MATH, MMLU, and GAIA.
content: Benchmarks cover diverse use cases in code generation, mathematical reasoning, knowledge and reasoning understanding, and tool usage.
Evaluation includes performance, cost, and generalization.

panels.headline: DAAO outperforms SOTA baseline MasRouter on MATH with 65% training cost and 41% inference cost.
content: DAAO surpasses existing methods by 3.5% to 15.2% in performance.
Demonstrates strong generalization and transferability across datasets.
panels.figure_caption: Performance comparison across baseline prompting strategies, single-agent methods, autonomous agentic workflows, and LLM routing approaches.

panels.headline: DAAO effectively balances complexity and cost, showing potential for real-world applications.
content: DAAO balances complexity and cost in generating query-specific multi-agent workflows.
Significantly outperforms existing methods in accuracy and efficiency.
Future work includes improving difficulty estimation and expanding to more domains.
